value.title: Workflow annotations
value.excerpt:
This PR adds 3 new jobs to the weekly-annotation-queues workflow that automatically build and populate a Langfuse annotation queue for human review of the Code quality judge.

Jobs added:

pullLangfuseTraces — Fetches all Code quality judge v5 scores from Langfuse for the past 7 days, deduplicating to one score per observation (keeping the most recent). Passes the results and window metadata through state.

extractCandidates — Selects up to 20 observations for review: the 5 lowest-scoring, 5 highest-scoring, and 10 randomly sampled from the remainder. Each selected observation is tagged with a reason (e.g. low Code quality judge v5 (0.1)).

postTraces — Creates a new named Langfuse annotation queue (with a random suffix to ensure uniqueness) configured with the 5 human review score configs, then adds each selected observation as a queue item.
